name: Lubricating oils (petroleum), C >25, solvent-extd., deasphalted, dewaxed, hydrogenated; Baseoil - unspecified; [A complex combination of hydrocarbons obtained by solvent extraction and hydrogenation of vacuum distillation residues. It consists predominantly of hydrocarbons having carbon numbers predominantly greater than C25 and produces a finished oil with a viscosity in the order of 32cSt to 37cSt at 100 °C (212 °F).]
